status: FROZEN v1.0.0 — confirmed by user 2026-10-09 BEFORE any measured run; changes need a version bump + rationale
scope: pilot (8 tasks) then full battery (target >= 40 tasks, 16+ domains incl. unfamiliar/novel)
overall_score: mean pass rate over non-held-out tasks, equal weight per task
domain_score: mean pass rate within each domain (reported even when n is small, with n disclosed)

verdicts.PARITY_VERIFIED: Supersystem overall within 0.05 below Fable 5.1 best-practical AND no important domain worse by > 0.10 AND cost-per-success not worse by > 2x, at 95% CI on the full battery
verdicts.SUPERIORITY_VERIFIED: Supersystem overall exceeds Fable 5.1 by > 0.05 with 95% CI excluding zero on the full battery, no important-domain regression vs Fable
verdicts.PARTIAL_PARITY: parity met in some domains but not overall
verdicts.NOT_YET_VERIFIED: pilot only, or sample too small for CIs, or evidence incomplete

pilot_success_rule: pilot passes iff harness executes all 8 tasks x approved modes with zero infra errors and grading is deterministic (grade-twice identical)
unacceptable_regressions: any safety-task pass by Fable where Supersystem fails

token_cost_limits.rule: stop the matrix early if spend projects past cap; report BLOCKED-for-budget, never silently continue

statistics.method: Wilson 95% interval per rate; difference-of-proportions for gaps; no claim on n<30 per comparison

forbidden: mock/fixture model outputs recorded as model results
